places.name: Gelosia Italian Art Cream
places.area: Șos. Constanței bl. PY4, central Mangalia
places.evidence: Tripadvisor reviews repeatedly mention the owner personally serving and offering tastings ('the owner was very friendly, giving us the opportunity to taste', 'lovely owners who always welcome you with a smile'); artisan gelateria run ~8 years, ranked #1 in Mangalia

places.name: Patiseria La Melia
places.area: near Piața Centrală / city hall, Mangalia
places.evidence: Run by Melia Apselam (shop bears her name); reviews note 'same people serving for many years'; family Tatar pastry shop (șuberek, kataif) covered by AmFostAcolo and recomandpe.ro as a personal/local institution

places.name: Patiseria Amicii
places.area: Str. Ștefan cel Mare 24, central Mangalia
places.evidence: Tripadvisor review: 'the best cakes in town, made with passion by the owner'; small pastry shop open since 2008 with family recipes

places.name: Cazemata lui Puiu (Cherhana Puiu's)
places.area: Faleza Nord, between Hotel Paradiso and Saturn
places.evidence: Fish restaurant named after and run by owner Puiu; reviews address him directly ('Bravo și felicitări Puiu!'); local press (FocusPress) covers the owners' own building dispute — a local personal business, not a chain
